transcript.speaker: Marcus Chen <marcus@lumenlabs.io>
transcript.text: Thanks everyone. Quick recap: Northwind Ops hit a 504 on export for boards over two thousand rows. Priya says it blocks their Friday reporting.

transcript.speaker: Tomás Herrera <tomas@lumenlabs.io>
transcript.text: Root cause is the synchronous CSV build in the request path. Anything above roughly fifteen hundred rows blows the thirty second gateway limit.

transcript.speaker: You <you@lumenlabs.io>
transcript.text: Proposal: move export to a background job and email a download link. I'll write the postmortem and send it to Marcus by Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Chen <marcus@lumenlabs.io>
transcript.text: Agreed, let's go with the background job for Q3. I'll notify Northwind about the workaround today.

transcript.speaker: Dana Kowalski <dana@lumenlabs.io>
transcript.text: I'll add the background export to the Q3 roadmap doc so we can size it Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Tomás Herrera <tomas@lumenlabs.io>
transcript.text: I can ship a quick fix that caps exports at fifteen hundred rows with a clear error by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Chen <marcus@lumenlabs.io>
transcript.text: Decision: cap at fifteen hundred rows with an error this week, background job lands in Q3. Action items are in the chat.
